dz: 英格兰国王亨利七世娶了爱德华四世之女约克的伊丽莎白为妻,统一了兰开斯特家族和约克家族.
de: King Henry VII of England marries Elizabeth of York, daughter of Edward IV, uniting the House of Lancaster and the House of York.

t: 徽宗皇帝让位给他的儿子钦宗皇帝。
te: Emperor Huizong abdicates the Chinese throne in favour of his son Emperor Qinzong.
dz: 徽宗皇帝让位给他的儿子钦宗皇帝。
de: Emperor Huizong abdicates the Chinese throne in favour of his son Emperor Qinzong.

t: 君士坦丁堡的尼卡暴动失败.
te: Nika riots in Constantinople fail.
dz: 君士坦丁堡的尼卡暴动失败.
de: Nika riots in Constantinople fail.

t: 七岁的利奥二世继承了外祖父利奥一世为拜占庭皇帝. 十个月后他就死了.
te: Seven-year-old Leo II succeeds his maternal grandfather Leo I as Byzantine emperor. He dies ten months later.
dz: 七岁的利奥二世继承了外祖父利奥一世为拜占庭皇帝. 十个月后他就死了.
de: Seven-year-old Leo II succeeds his maternal grandfather Leo I as Byzantine emperor. He dies ten months later.

t: 马格尼提乌斯将军被罗马贵族所宣称为皇帝,对康斯坦斯皇帝的统治不满.
te: General Magnentius is proclaimed emperor by Roman aristocrats discontent with the rule of emperor Constans.
dz: 马格尼提乌斯将军被罗马贵族所宣称为皇帝,对康斯坦斯皇帝的统治不满.
de: General Magnentius is proclaimed emperor by Roman aristocrats discontent with the rule of emperor Constans.
